thread.title: Is Tenable (TENB) a Sell? What does Berenberg Think?

author: Marie Mckinney
title: Is Tenable (TENB) a Sell? What does Berenberg Think?
text:
Posted by Marie Mckinney 1:49 am Why Has Berenberg Given Tenable (TENB) a $38.0 Price Target
Berenberg analyst started coverage with a Buy rating on Tenable (TENB) today and set a price target of $38.0. The firm’s shares opened today at 29.07.
The stock increased 3.67% or $1.03 $29.07. About 177,366 shares traded. Tenable Holdings, Inc. (TENB) has 0.00% . It has underperformed by 15.62% the S&P500.
Tenable Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. $2.71 billion. The Company’s enterprise software platform enables visibility into an organization's cyber exposure across the attack surface and deep insights that help organizations translate technical data into business insights to understand and reduce their cybersecurity risk. It currently has negative earnings. The firm offers Tenable.io, a software as a service that manages and measures cyber exposure across a range of traditional information technology assets, such as networking infrastructure, desktops, and on-premises servers, as well as modern information technology assets, such as cloud workloads, containers, Web applications, and Internet of things and operational technology assets; and SecurityCenter, a solution to manage and measure cyber exposure across traditional information technology assets and can be run on-premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid environment.
